dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Hello there, friend from afar. Are you going shopping?

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: As it happens, I'm doing so too. Would you mind if I join you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about this street?

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: This street is the busiest place in Inazuma. Not only can you get the daily necessities here, but you can also purchase rare, high-end, and exotic goods. It's my favorite spot.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: It's a shame that you've come at such a moment. If it were before the Sakoku Decree, you would even be able to find fine liquor from Mondstadt or handcrafted jewelry from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Now, I would recommend that you check out the old local stores, like Ogura Textiles & Kimonos. You will find the latest and the finest outfits there.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: The owner of Yayoi Lacquerware seems to have lived abroad before. She can perform craftsmanship that would otherwise be unique to Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: There's also Netsuke no Gen Crafts... and Uyuu Restaurant...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: If you have already seen every corner of this street, you can also check Hanamizaka out... However...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're really familiar, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Indeed. I have all the spare money in the world but nothing to do with it, so shopping is my greatest hobby.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: My family also runs a business, so I check the market regularly to stay informed.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Oh, right. If you find anything interesting while checking the market out, remember to let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Bye. This place is worth your time, I guarantee it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: However...?

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Ah, don't get me wrong. Hanamizaka is also a fine place to check out. You can go to Yae Publishing House to buy a novel, have a fine meal at Kiminami Restaurant... That would already make for a leisurely day indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: However, I heard rumors that there was a weirdo with a pair of long horns frequenting Hanamizaka...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: I've heard that this man is very mean and overbearing, so much so that even Madam Kujou Sara from the Tenryou Commission considers him a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: But I've also heard it said that this weird man is not a thug. He just hangs out with the children all day, playing card games or setting up a bug-fighting arena...

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if I should buy into any of these rumors... Anyway, if you happen to find yourself there, it's best to be a bit more careful.
